narration_script: Self-control is a short-term strategy. It is not a long-term solution. The people with the best self-control are the ones who need to use it the least. Because they design their environment to reduce temptation. The secret is not to summon willpower every time. The secret is to reduce exposure to the cue. You cannot fail at a habit you never start because the trigger never appears. This is why the most disciplined people structure their lives around reducing temptation rather than resisting it.
